transitions.description: Canonical visual and routing events on Scene boundaries.

outputContract.description: Immutable authored promise for the Show's output.

composition.description: Optional additive local composition alongside the global timeline.

outputEffects.description: Ordered full-Show output Effects, after clip composition and Transitions.

importMetadata.description: Durable provenance for a Show created from a portable authored bundle.

routingTargets.description: Show-wide property targets that take effect during this scene.

icon.description: Optional stable visual identifier used when timeline headers become narrow.

zoneMode.description: How a multi-zone clip maps its Pattern domain. Defaults to one continuous span.

restartOnEntry.description: Start this destination with a fresh Pattern instance instead of continuing matching state.

evaluationPolicy.description: Evaluate continuously, freeze one complete entry frame, or refresh one quarter of pixels per frame.

presentation.description: Placement-owned RGB presentation. Live is the default when omitted.

blink.description: Placement-owned visibility gate; Pattern-instance time continues while hidden.

controlTargets.description: Scene-owned 0..1 targets for public slider control functions.

transform.description: Canonical placement transform, applied before optional ordered Effects. Missing is neutral.

viewport.description: Preserved when disabled so later re-enable restores the authored frame.

effects.description: Ordered single-source visual Effects. Affine operation order is significant.

ShowClipTransform.description: Stable placement-owned affine pose. Rotation is persisted in signed turns around (0.5, 0.5).

aperture.description: Aperture silhouette inscribed in the frame. Missing = rectangle (#591).

edge.description: Edge treatment. Missing defaults Soft for every aperture shape.

feather.description: Authored soft-band width in normalized Zone units. Missing = density default.

rotation.description: Silhouette rotation in turns within the frame. Missing = axis-aligned (#690).

invert.description: The silhouette cuts out instead of admitting (#690).

ringWidth.description: Ring only: band thickness as a fraction of the unit radius.

cornerRadius.description: Rounded-box only: corner radius as a fraction of the half-side.

crossWidth.description: Cross only: arm width as a fraction of the frame half-extent.

crescentOffset.description: Crescent only: cutout offset as a fraction of the unit radius.

ShowClipApertureShape.description: Optional placement-owned clipping frame in normalized Zone coordinates.

routingDirection.description: Stable directional threshold used when a routing marker has nonzero duration.

propertyTransitions.description: Boundary-owned interpolation settings keyed by the destination clip.

ShowBoundaryTransition.description: A selectable event on the shared boundary lane.

controls.description: Public Pixelblaze slider export name -> the same shared transition descriptor.

transform.description: Stable canonical placement Transform property -> shared clip-property descriptor.

effects.description: Stable Effect id -> public numeric parameter -> shared clip-property descriptor.

executionModel.description: New timeline execution contract; absent preserves legacy compiled artifacts.

durationMs.description: Explicit deterministic loop boundary in absolute Show time.

markers.description: Global guides; Markers may remain dormant beyond Show End.

transitions.description: Non-Cut transitions; endpoint-owned Cuts remain implicit and lossless.

groupDefinitions.description: Reusable choreography definitions, omitted when the Show has no Groups.

groupOccurrences.description: Zone- and Layout-interval-local placements of Group definitions.

ShowCompositionV1.description: Additive Scene-composition sidecar. Version 1 carries mutually exclusive Main schedules, manually ordered overlay layers, typed Scene-local property animation tracks, and endpoint-owned non-Cut Layer transitions.

evaluationPolicy.description: Evaluate continuously, freeze one complete entry frame, or refresh one quarter of pixels per frame.

ShowPatternInstance.description: Show-owned private Pattern state referenced by one or more local placements.

propertyTracks.description: Authored tracks only. Static values remain inline on their typed owners.

parameterId.description: Visual-toolkit parameter id, such as translateX or amount.

ShowPropertyAnimationTarget.description: Structured identity for one numeric value authored inside a Scene.

timeMs.description: Whole milliseconds relative to the owning Scene.

easing.description: Interpolation used while leaving this keyframe.
